prompt:
You receive 4 images. Image 1 is the LAYOUT SKETCH of the finished 1920x1080 game screen: a crude flat-colour blocking that fixes the exact composition - camera, horizon, wall and floor lines, and the position, size and outline of every object. Repaint image 1 into a finished painting: keep every line and every block exactly where it is and exactly as large as it is, paint each block as the object described below, do not move, enlarge, shrink, add or remove anything, and leave no flat colour areas or hard geometric edges. Images 2-3 are photos of the real place (geography, architecture, materials and real details to paint from; they are references only, do not copy their camera, cars, people, signs or weather). Image 4 is a finished background painting from our game: use it ONLY as the reference for the painting technique (brushwork, palette, edge softness, level of detail, line quality); do not copy anything from its scene.

Place: grandmother Mira's old single-storey house in the old core of Čierna Voda on Pezinská street (municipality Chorvátsky Grob, near Bratislava, Slovakia), seen now from its narrow side path inside the plot. Image 2 is a dashcam photo of the real house type of this street: a low 1950s-70s village house with a red-brown tiled roof, pale peach and light blue plaster and white windows. Image 3 is our finished painting of the street front of this same invented house (gate, workshop, green picket fence, grapevine, peach plaster, white windows with lace curtains): paint the side wall of Mira's house so that it is clearly the same house - same plaster colour, windows, lace curtains, roller-blind boxes, green fence and vine - but do not copy that picture's street view.

Brief: a narrow outdoor side path along the house, separated from the lived-in part of the garden by a low fence. Mira is in quarantine and talks with her grandson by phone through her big closed window; a family photo hangs inside on the wall, visible through the glass. Thursday 29 October 2020, a sunny autumn afternoon around half past three: warm low sunlight from the left across the wall, soft shadows to the right, yellowing vine leaves, a few fallen leaves on the path.

Camera: eye-level, straight-on view of the side wall; vertical lines stay vertical. The wall meets the path along one straight horizontal line at y 780. Keep this exact geometry from the sketch: the red-brown tiled roof overhang and its pale soffit along the top edge (y 0-70), the brown roller-blind boxes at y 112-136, the tall white windows from y 136 down to their sills at y 594-608, the transom bars at y 258-272, the rough plinth y 690-780, the path from y 780 down to the bottom edge, the house corner at x 980.

What the sketch blocks are: the side wall of the house in pale peach plaster with a grey drainpipe at the corner; three tall old white-framed double windows, each with a fixed upper transom pane and two tall casements below, all closed: window A on the left, window B in the middle - Mira's big window with the lace curtains drawn aside to the edges and the dim, empty room behind the glass - and window C on the right with closed lace curtains; deep window sills; right of the house corner a low weathered green picket fence (the same as in image 3) separating the path from Mira's garden: behind it the lawn, the old grapevine on a wooden trellis with yellowing leaves and dark blue grapes, an old fruit tree in autumn colours, the neighbours' trees and a piece of blue sky; the narrow side path of old square concrete slabs.

Interactive props - each painted clearly inside its block, the same size as its block, easy to recognise at a glance:
1. the block of the layout sketch at x 120-240, y 150-250 of the 1920x1080 frame (6-12 % from the left, 14-23 % from the top): seen through the upper transom pane of window A, a framed family photograph hanging high on the inner wall of the room: a grandmother with white hair and her grown-up grandson at the seaside, with a slightly crooked horizon.
2. the block of the layout sketch at x 425-545, y 150-250 of the 1920x1080 frame (22-28 % from the left, 14-23 % from the top): a terracotta pot of red trailing geraniums hanging on a short chain from the eave, in front of the upper transom pane of window B.
3. the block of the layout sketch at x 730-850, y 150-250 of the 1920x1080 frame (38-44 % from the left, 14-23 % from the top): the gathered top of the old white lace curtain filling the upper transom pane of window C.

Walkable floor: the band at x 90-1830, y 790-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (5-95 % from the left, 73-94 % from the top) is the narrow side path of old concrete slabs - one continuous flat surface with no kerb, no step, no edge and no change of material inside it, and nothing standing on it: no pots, no tools, no bins, no hoses, no bags. Only light, soft shadows and a few fallen leaves. The path continues to the left edge towards the gate (the area of the layout sketch at x 50-105, y 975-1045 of the 1920x1080 frame (3-5 % from the left, 90-97 % from the top)).
NPC zone at x 385-535, y 450-770 of the 1920x1080 frame (20-28 % from the left, 42-71 % from the top): an animated character sprite will stand here later, so paint only plain, uncluttered background in it - no person, no figure, no silhouette, no clothes on hooks that read as a person. The upper part of this zone is the lower panes of window B above the sill: paint the dim, empty room behind the glass with a soft reflection, the lace curtains only at the window edges; below the sill it is plain wall and plinth.

Fiction rules: the house and its interior are invented. No house numbers, no names, no text, no people (the photo shows two small painted figures only), no animals.

The layout sketch is a blocking aid only: paint over all of it. Do NOT draw frames, borders, outlines or boxes around objects, and keep no flat colour block. The finished picture contains no UI, no captions, no text except what is asked for above, no watermark and no people or animals.

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
